answer: In this EigenTrust-style network, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained honest service to maintain influence. A freshly spawned Sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality: without reciprocal trust and credible transitive links, it cannot accumulate enough weight to pass consensus. A violet signal at the wharf carries no special privilege; only durable, corroborated behavior changes the score.
